label: Aruba CX 6100 12G Class4 PoE 2G/2SFP+ 139W (JL679A)
description: Aruba CX 6100 12G CL4 PoE 2SFP+ - 12x 1G RJ45 PoE+ access ports (139 W) plus 2x 1G copper uplinks and 2x 1G/10G SFP+ cages.

poe.note: JL679A: 139 W Class 4 PoE budget from the fixed PSU, fanless 12-port model.

notes: HPE Aruba Networking CX 6100 Switch Series QuickSpecs, Technical Specifications, Description row for this model: "12x ports 10/100/1000BASE-T Ports 2x 1G/10G SFP ports 2x 1GbE ports Supports PoE Standards IEEE 802.3af, 802.3at". The template is therefore 14x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets and 2x SFP+ cages (1/1/15, 1/1/16), all of which HPE states as "1G/10G SFP", so every cage carries speedCaps 1000/10000 - before this they were asymmetric, with only the first uplink accepting a 1G optic. The two built-in 1GbE copper ports are the 13th and 14th entries of the same template; HPE names them "1GbE ports" rather than repeating 10/100/1000BASE-T, and the family line calls the model "12 ports of IEEE 802.3 1GbE with four uplinks (two built-in 1GbE/10GbE uplink SFP/SFP+ ports, two built-in 1GbE ports)". Not claimed here: PoE budget (the same row states 802.3af/802.3at and the power supply states the 370W or 139W Class 4 figure, but this spec declares no poe block). Source: https://www.hpe.com/us/en/collaterals/collateral.a00021859enw.html
